title: fix(console): Shared in Add view only for administrators who can write it, and published at once (#36409)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #36409

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 列表视图下拉的「添加视图」里，「共享」这个选项现在只给真正能保存共享视图的管理员；组织管理员以前能看到这个选项，点了却被服务器拒绝，现在不再显示。管理员新建的共享视图保存后立刻对所有人可见，不用另外发布。打开的视图如果已经不存在，会提示一次，然后显示默认视图。
- 属于「列表专题」，按维护者定的规则「只有管理员可以在前端界面创建共享视图」和「保存即生效」；把已有视图设为共享或取消共享，维护者说暂时不考虑，本 PR 不做。
- 若出错，影响的是管理员新建共享视图这一步：保存被拒时会提示原因，不会发布任何东西；本改动可以整体撤回，已存的视图不受影响。
- 无

## What changes

#36371 closed as not planned: the rule it asked for already holds (correction 7077377066), and sharing or unsharing an existing view is not wanted now. Building it measured three real faults at `origin/main` 3faabd26, which #36409 files; this PR fixes those three and nothing else. The 「设为共享」 / 「取消共享」 row actions an earlier head carried are gone (code, keys, tests, docs).

- **The server refusal already holds.** A shared view is `view` metadata written through `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/:name`; that door, the publish and the delete refuse any caller without `manage_metadata` (`metaSaveVerdict`, ADR-0066 D1), answering `403 FORBIDDEN`. No server code changes; the refusal is pinned with the shipped permission sets (below).

1. **Who is offered Shared** (`mayShareViews`, `objectViewViewSharing.ts`): an administrator whose session holds `manage_metadata` (`useCanAuthorMetadata`). Add view used to ask `isAdmin` alone, which is true for an organization administrator, who does not hold the capability: they were offered Shared and the save answered `403`.
2. **Shared at once.** A view created Shared used to be saved as a draft (ADR-0034), invisible to everyone until someone published it. It is now saved and published in one act through the door #35955 uses (`saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`, ruling record 7058616478, the maintainer's 「保存即生效」). That helper now saves a new view into the app's package when the caller passes the app, as `createRuntimeMetadata` does (objectstack#35624); existing callers pass none and are unchanged. A refused save publishes nothing.
3. **A view that is gone.** A reader whose address names a view the server answers `not_found` for is told so once, and the list shows its default view, as it already did silently. `useMetaItemRefusal` gains `absent` for that verdict.

Two new `@object-ui/i18n` keys under `view.switcher` (`shareNameTaken`, `viewGone`) in every pack (zh-Hant regenerated), so `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` gains a Shared views paragraph. No published skill describes this surface (`git grep` of `skills/` for My views / shared view: zero hits), so no `Skills-docs:` line is owed.

Not done here: 「设为共享」 / 「取消共享」 on existing views (not now, per the maintainer), saving into a shared view (#35955 step 2), the Manage views page.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-write-door-capability-enumeration.test.ts`, new describe `#36409`: with the systemPermissions the shipped sets grant (`securityDefaultPermissionSets`), a member (`member_default`) and an organization administrator (`member_default` + `organization_admin`) are refused the view's save, publish and delete `403 FORBIDDEN` with the protocol never reached; the control, `admin_full_access`, reaches all three.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewViewSharing.test.tsx` (new): who is offered Shared (an administrator holding `manage_metadata`; neither half alone); Create shared saves with the first-write pin and publishes, then opens the view; a refused save is said, reported unsaved, and publishes nothing; a name an unpublished draft already holds is said (`shareNameTaken`) and nothing is published, refreshed or opened.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.saveAndPublishIntoApp-36409.test.ts` (new, a real `MetadataClient` over the package doors' measured bodies): with an app, a writable app package is named on the save; an installed one gets the pair the ensure door returns; an unlisted one, `packageId: null` or no app gets none; the publish and a refused publish's discard name no package (ADR-0146 D8); a `dashboard` call ignores the app and asks no package door.

### Readings at head b09dc558 (main ff601499 merged); `65544511` adds the two pins

- `objectViewViewSharing.test.tsx` 3/3; `@object-ui/i18n` with the switcher, sharing, in-place-create and census tests: 110 files, 2,032 passed; every `ObjectView*` test with `runtime-metadata-persistence`, the census, the switcher, the sharing and in-place-create tests: 114 files, 1,021 passed. `meta-write-door-capability-enumeration.test.ts`: 72 passed.
- Ablation: `mayShareViews` reduced to `return isAdmin;` turns the organization-administrator test red (1 failed / 2 passed); restored, green.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`): 96 derived, 94 run, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. NOT MEASURED (prerequisite exit 3), left to CI: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (shallow-clone fixture) and spec `check:skill-examples` (needs client-react declarations). `ui vitest run scripts/`, spec `check:docs` and `check:dts-closure` were red only until `@objectstack/spec` was rebuilt with declarations after the main merge, then green. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` stays red on this container's tree alone: 75 findings, each a `.d.ts`/`.d.cts` of a package this PR does not touch (`core`, the drivers, …) never emitted here; CI's build is its reading.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against main and every open PR head.
- At `65544511`: the new package pins 5/5 and the sharing test 4/4; `runtime-metadata-persistence*` 8 files, 63 passed. Ablations: `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata` reading `ctx.app` for every type turns the dashboard pin red; resolving no package turns the four view pins red; `publishNew` ignoring `'pending-draft'` turns the `shareNameTaken` pin red; each restored, green. The test-reading gate families (27) re-run at this tree: green but the one NOT MEASURED above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Organization administrators elsewhere on the list page: #36448.** Manage views, the view settings panel and the Create View dialog still gate on `isAdmin` alone, so an organization administrator without `manage_metadata` is still offered those and refused by the server. This PR narrows only the Shared choice #36409 names; #36448 carries the rest.
- **Organization administrators** were not driven live: the showcase seeds no organization-administrator persona. Their gate is the unit pin above and the server's `403` pin.
- **The de quote-pair count pin** (`de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`) is no longer touched: the dropped German strings were the ones with quotes, so #36387 owns that pin alone.

## Screenshots

Taken at `a0dfe1a4` in a live Console (`ui/apps/console` Vite against `examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin`), 1400×900 at 2×, two accounts: the dev administrator `admin@objectos.ai` and the seeded member persona `auditor.demo@example.com`, on Projects. That head still carried the dropped row actions; the shots below show only what this PR keeps, which the slimming did not change. The files are kept with the project, named here as they are attached there.

- `a2-admin-addview-shared.png`: administrator, Add view with **My views / Shared**, Shared chosen, the hint under it. Created, it opened at once as `showcase_project.key_projects`.
- `m1-member-menu.png`, `m2-member-addview.png`: the member, opening that view by its address, finds it under Shared views straight away (no publish step), and Add view has no My views / Shared choice.
- `m3-member-view-gone.png`: the member reloads the address of a view that was removed: 「The view you opened is no longer available, so the list shows its default view.」 over All Projects.

## Verification

Two-minute check: as a platform administrator, open a list's view dropdown, Add view, choose Shared and create; sign in as a member and open the list: the view is under Shared views at once, and Add view offers no Shared choice.
